groups.contract: Durable injury addition, projection, blood settlement and exposure
groups.disposition: Complete literal P16 bodies and all actual PR deltas consumed. Seven initialized injury keys preserve full u64 identity and region; fracture is maxed within bruising in projected damage so not counted twice. Native commit_aggregated_hit_injury adds raw nonnegative cut/blunt, retains largest-hit fracture semantics, and delegates uncapped DC; supplied actual encounter applied-vs-logged mismatch Root04F043 remains connected. Finite raw damage totals can overflow after repeated/raw extreme adds; no normal applied-hit producer extreme established here, so retain damage-owner/Root04F057 computed-DC dependency rather than promote ordinary clinical failure. Frostbite only peripheral and clamps to1, separate from cut/bruise, no blood/projectile. Recovery duration is min(requested), terminal settlement uses actual interval elapsed; surgery deliberately never advances CharacterTime itself. BodyRegion fixed-array indexing matches seven collected cuts. Exposure is accumulated f32, divided/floored to saturating u32 count then enumerated with monotonic check+1 only below completed; no counter wrap in loop, but huge interval/exposure can request billions of writes and precision may plateau. Actual duration/work owner remains time-lens dependency; no enormous accepted gameplay interval/run asserted.

Inventory quantity sums are unchecked u32 across rows, same aggregate-capacity NativeF047 graph; actual huge stock not established. Single-unit consume selects positive before subtraction. Splint split subtracts only quantity>1, tracked row+owner returned only exact one splint; direct raw split insertion and stable physical object lifetime remain M29 dependency, no measured/food singleton extrapolation. Exact receipt binds every procedure/projectile/soap/context/revision field before mutable checks; interrupted time returns before receipt/supply consumption. Different actor/patient align once, self participant advances once. Common safe disease/injury interval is min of all previews. Context and presence rechecked after time; chosen extraction projectile was validated before time and post-wait contextual decision is actual aggregate dependency, not proof every raw projectile row is reloaded. Soap uses canonical measured fraction and consumes one cleansing point; alcohol delegates checked owner. Several writes precede later fallible children; SDK rollback remains a dependency. Source-static only.
